SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / REGISTRY. / 3584 / Do. 29/4/32）

Translation of letter from Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court.
No. 4554.                                                                 April    27,    1932.

Messrs. Inspectors General,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

    I am in receipt of a letter No. 451 from the
Kiangsu Provincial Government to the Police Department :-
    "With reference to our previous despatch requesting
your assistance in effecting the arrest of two persons
named Kao I (高義) and Yang Han Hsien (楊漢烈), both
military officers attached to the National Army, who
were ordered under instructional order from the
Military Council in November 1927, we have to inform you
that an application has been recently made by the Chairman
of the Kiangsu Provincial Government, General Tang Sheng Chih,
to the National Government to the effect that a resolution
was passed in the 16th meeting on March 1st and resolved
that the circular orders for their arrests be withdrawn
on the ground that both the accused had shown repentance
and exerted themselves in suppressing bandits. As a result
of a resolution passed in the 16th meeting of the Executive
Yuan, the application was granted and an instructional order
No. 901 was issued to the Ministry for Interior Affairs to
this effect, who informed us in a letter No. 515 and re-
quested that this information be widely circulated."

    I have to inform you as above and wish you will
have this information circulated among your districts.

（批：XI Memo. / Inspector (CR) / 29/4/32）

Chen Sion Woh
President.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总监办公室。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 登记室 / 3584 / 同上 1932年4月29日）

上海第一特区地方法院来函译文。
第 4554 号。                                                                 1932 年 4 月 27 日。

致各位总督察，
上海。

先生们：

    本人收到江苏省政府致警务处第 451 号函件如下：
    “关于本府此前去函请求协助逮捕高義（Kao I）和杨漢烈（Yang Han Hsien）二人一事，该二人均为国民革命军军官，曾于 1927 年 11 月奉军事委员会指令令予以逮捕。现特通知贵处，江苏省政府主席唐生智将军近期向国民政府提出申请，称在 3 月 1 日举行的第 16 次会议上通过决议，鉴于两名被告均表示悔过并在剿匪工作中效力，决定撤销对其的通缉令。经行政院第 16 次会议决议，批准了该项申请，并向内政部颁发了第 901 号指令令以传达此意，内政部在第 515 号函中告知本府，并要求广泛通报此信息。”

    特此如上通知，望贵处在各辖区传达此信息。

（批注：XI 备忘录 / 督察 (CR) / 1932年4月29日）

陈雄沃（Chen Sion Woh）(音译)
院长。
